basic_details.department: Women Development & Child Welfare Department (WCD&SC), Rajanna Sircilla District
basic_details.short_information: Women Development and Child Welfare Department (WCD&SC), Rajanna Sircilla District has released the Anganwadi Teacher Recruitment 2026 notification for filling vacant Anganwadi Teacher posts under ICDS Projects. A total of 55 Anganwadi Teacher vacancies are available in Siricilla and Vemulawada ICDS Projects. Interested women candidates can submit their applications through the official online portal. The online application process started on 28 July 2026 and the last date to apply is 7 August 2026 up to 5:00 PM.

qualification.details: Candidates should have passed 10th Class (SSC) or equivalent qualification. The applicant must satisfy the local eligibility conditions prescribed for Anganwadi recruitment.

selection_process: The selection of candidates will be carried out according to the rules prescribed by the Women Development and Child Welfare Department.
Verification of application details Checking of educational qualification Verification of local area eligibility Preparation of merit list Document verification
Only candidates satisfying all eligibility conditions will be considered for final selection.
how_to_apply: Visit the official WCD Telangana application portal.
Open the Anganwadi Teacher recruitment application link.
Select Rajanna Sircilla District and the applicable ICDS Project.
Enter personal and educational details carefully.
Upload the required certificates and documents.
Submit the application before the last date.
Take a printout of the submitted application for future reference.
important_instructions: Candidates should apply only for vacancies available in their eligible area. Applications submitted after the last date will not be considered. All uploaded documents should be clear and valid. False information or incorrect documents may lead to cancellation of candidature. Candidates should keep the application details safely for future reference. Selection will be based on the rules issued by the Women Development and Child Welfare Department.

rows.women_development_child_welfare_departme: Siricilla ICDS Project and Vemulawada ICDS Project

content_sections.heading: Rajanna Sircilla Anganwadi Vacancy 2026 Distribution
content_sections.text: The vacancies are available across two ICDS projects. Candidates can apply for the Anganwadi Teacher vacancy available in their eligible local area/project. The official notification mentions that Siricilla ICDS Project has 43 Anganwadi Teacher vacancies , while Vemulawada ICDS Project has 12 Anganwadi Teacher vacancies .

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply for Rajanna Sircilla Anganwadi Teacher Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Only eligible women candidates fulfilling the local area and educational conditions mentioned in the notification can apply for the Anganwadi Teacher posts. Candidates should have passed 10th Class (SSC) or equivalent qualification. The applicant must satisfy the local eligibility conditions prescribed for Anganwadi recruitment. Age will be calculated as on 01 July 2026 . Candidates must be between 18 and 35 years of age.

content_sections.heading: Rajanna Sircilla Anganwadi Teacher Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The selection of candidates will be carried out according to the rules prescribed by the Women Development and Child Welfare Department. The selection process generally includes: Verification of application details Checking of educational qualification Verification of local area eligibility Preparation of merit list Document verification Only candidates satisfying all eligibility conditions will be considered for final selection.

content_sections.heading: Special Category Reservation in Anganwadi Recruitment
content_sections.text: The vacancy list includes reserved positions under different categories such as SC, ST, BC, EWS, OC and other special categories. Candidates applying under reserved categories must submit valid supporting certificates. The vacancy statement includes details such as AWC name, ICDS project, reservation category and vacancy status for individual Anganwadi centres.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for Rajanna Sircilla Anganwadi Application 2026
content_sections.text: SSC / 10th Class Marks Memo Date of Birth Certificate Aadhaar Card Educational qualification certificates Caste Certificate, if applicable Income Certificate, if applicable Local Residence Certificate Special category certificates, if applicable Recent passport-size photograph Other required supporting documents

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Rajanna Sircilla Anganwadi Teacher Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official WCD Telangana application portal. Open the Anganwadi Teacher recruitment application link. Select Rajanna Sircilla District and the applicable ICDS Project. Enter personal and educational details carefully. Upload the required certificates and documents. Submit the application before the last date. Take a printout of the submitted application for future reference.
